## RgbHelpers interface

Construction and conversion of [Rgb](./contracts.rgb.md) colors.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface RgbHelpers
```

## Remarks

Every helper validates its input and throws `RangeError` on a channel that is not an integer in range; nothing is clamped.
